newsitem.title: FINLAND: Summit notebook - Star Wars and protocol crockery.
newsitem.headline: Summit notebook - Star Wars and protocol crockery.

text.p: While the U.S. and Russian presidents dined in a spirit of peace on Thursday evening and got ready to discuss arms control, Helsinki-dwellers had a sneak preview of the latest Star Wars film.
Distributor Finnkino said the premiere date was set well ahead of the two-day summit, but the preview for nearly 700 Finns was "a happy coincidence".

Summit protocol meant carting a load of white gilt-rimmed official U.S. crockery to Finnish President Martti Ahtisaari's official residence, Mantyniemi, where the United States was hosting Friday's lunch.
Ahtisaari hosted Thursday evening's supper. President Boris Yeltsin was due to host a supper before President Bill Clinton heads back to Washington.

Internet summiteers said thousands worldwide visited their video and audio sites showing the presidents' arrivals on Thursday. State broadcaster YLE said its home page had a "colossal" 55,000 "hits" or visits, with 3,300 at its video site. A4 Media reported 6,500 "hits" for its web camera.
Both sites can be reached through http://virtual.finland.fi.
A Finnish designer who gave U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright a "busy bee" bright red scarf was delighted to see her wearing it on Thursday.
"So far I have not spotted the new ties on either of the presidents," said Marja Kurki.
